aliases: Sensitivity AOV — Sensitivity as an Arbitrary Output Variable
Sensitivity as an Arbitrary Output Variable
definition: A render output carrying the sensitivity of a scalar objective M with respect to scene parameters θ. It allows human inspection of which parts of a scene matter for a given goal, analogous to how primal AOVs expose intermediate light transport quantities.
summary: Sensitivity AOVs use a single adjoint pass to reveal which scene parameters matter for an objective, enabling multi-viewpoint inspection without recomputing gradients.
